name: jetchris- The 7-Mobile's Billiards Blast (Beta V.7)
author: jetchris
description: Get in and ride the Multiples of 7-Mobile on a giant pool table!                            Use arrow keys to drive.  Knock all the balls into the pockets in 180 seconds or less.  Good luck and thanks for playing!    Thank you Lucas, Chris, and Solonari for your help with geometry and player control!  You're the best!
